A black hole is a place in space where gravity is so strong that nothing — not even light — can escape from it.
• It forms when a massive star collapses. • The center is called a singularity. • The edge is called the event horizon. • Black holes can be detected by the way they affect nearby stars, light and space.
In short: it's like a cosmic vacuum with super-strong gravity. 10:24 AM
